name: whisper-cpp
description: This pin crosses the qvac-ext-lib-whisper.cpp repo reorg (QIP #94: symmetric engines/ layout, upstream whisper.cpp vendored as a git subtree under third_party/whisper.cpp with a declared, CI-guarded delta): tts-cpp sources moved tts-cpp/ -> engines/tts/, parakeet-cpp/ -> engines/parakeet/, whisper root -> third_party/whisper.cpp/. Path updates validated end-to-end pre-merge via overlay ports (tetherto/qvac#3310): Device Farm mobile e2e 3/3 addons, desktop integration across platforms. tts-cpp additionally picks up the Parler-TTS engine (mini-v1/large-v1, CPU; qvac-ext-lib-whisper.cpp#92). High-performance inference of OpenAI's Whisper automatic speech recognition (ASR) model

metal.description: Enable Metal GPU acceleration (Apple-only; targets macOS and iOS via the ggml-metal backend in ggml-speech). No extra package dependencies — Metal.framework is provided by the platform SDK.

opencl.description: Enable OpenCL GPU acceleration (Android-only; targets Adreno via the ggml-opencl backend in ggml-speech).

vulkan.description: Enable Vulkan GPU acceleration (Linux/Windows/Android; macOS/iOS use the metal feature instead).
